units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30b:2">Ab. Zar. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>יין תּוֹסֵס וכ׳</he> wine in its first stage of fermentation does not come under the law concerning liquids left uncovered (<cite ref="C00729"><he>גִּילּוּי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:29">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:15">Tosef. Ter. VII, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:15">Ib.</cite> <he>וכמה תוסס וכ׳</he> and how long is it in that inceptive stage? &c., v. <cite ref="V00764">preced.</cite>
Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ bot. ראה … תוסס he saw the blood (of the prophet) boil; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2); (Snh. 96ᵇ; Gitt. 57ᵇ מרתח); a. fr.—2) to spurt.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>נתן אצבע על הצור התחילה תוֹסֶסֶת אש</he> he put his finger on the rock, and it began to spurt fire; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77">Gen. R. s. 77</cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 132">Yalk. ib. 132</cite> <he>התחילה האש תוססת</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:10">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:10">VII</cite>), 10 <he>התוסס אוד בכותל וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="A00841"><he>אור</he></cite>; ed. Zuckerm. <he>האומר חתום אוד</he>, corr. acc.) if one strikes a brand against the wall, and says, ‘here it is’, he is guilty of a superstitious practice (v. <cite ref="A02007"><he>אֱמוֹרִי</he></cite>), but if he does it for the sake of the sparks, it is permissible.
